nodes.natural_language: Let $u_n$ a sequence defined by $u_0 = 0$ and $\forall n \geq 0, u_{n+1} = 2 u_n + (n + 1)$. Show that $\forall n \geq 0, u(n) = 2^{n+1} - (n+2)$.
